causal_basis.project_evidence: Actor-only raw-action drift from applied-target 1M to 2M is 0.09495878 RMS versus 0.01407022 from normalization, a 6.749x ratio; later half/final checkpoints repeatedly exchange gate quality while all remain full-duration gaits.
causal_basis.external_inference: Stochastic Weight Averaging reports that averaging points along a constant- or cyclic-learning-rate SGD trajectory can find flatter solutions; transfer to this PPO trajectory is unproven and is tested rather than assumed.

transform.half_policy: arithmetic mean of step0 and half actor initializers; retain half obs_mean, obs_std, graph, and all nonactor initializers
transform.final_policy: arithmetic mean of step0, half, and final actor initializers; retain final obs_mean, obs_std, graph, and all nonactor initializers
transform.reason: The measured drift is actor-dominant; averaging normalizer moments is not the tested mechanism.

contract_before_behavior: archive and all member hashes exact
source graphs and input/output interfaces identical
actor initializers equal the frozen arithmetic means
normalizer and nonactor initializers equal the current raw checkpoint
R3 changes only six pitch-chain max_action_delta entries after averaging
state output equals bounded applied action and all inference outputs are finite

advance_rule.combination: same rate variant and tail arm must pass unchanged gate at both cumulative half and cumulative final checkpoints
advance_rule.gate: all six cells present, 600 ticks, duration complete, bilateral gait, zero saturation, zero measured rate excess, maximum pitch-chain tracking p95 <= 0.20 rad, and PASS_CANDIDATE_SIM_GATE
